dataset.title: Impaired iron recycling from erythrocytes is an early hallmark of aging

findings.message: The search identified an unusually small fraction of the MS2 spectra. Treat absence of a protein in this dataset as weak evidence. Producer's note: 8083/81031 = 9.98% of MS2 identified (S3)

no SDRF says which sample is in which channel (no curated design and no deposited SDRF); PXReprise's default design makes each file its own plex and each channel that shows a sample its own sample (marked empty, holding none: 126 in 3 file(s), 127N in 3 file(s), 127C in 3 file(s), 128N in 3 file(s), 128C in 3 file(s), 129N in 3 file(s), 129C in 3 file(s), 134C in 3 file(s), 135N in 3 file(s)); the reporter values compare nothing until a design is curated (QuantProject 079)

No SDRF was found for this dataset, so each channel's sample is the sample its search's TmtDesign.txt names (its `Sample Name`), with nothing else known about it. There is no sample metadata: treat every sample as unannotated.

Some modifications on peptides shared between proteins were not written to ptm_sites for one or more of those proteins, because the peptide could not be located in that protein's sequence and the producer's residue spans cannot be paired with its accessions. Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 63 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.

2 modification(s) could not be mapped to a UNIMOD accession or a mass, and are carried in ProForma as [Info:...] tags: UniProt:N6-crotonyllysine on K, UniProt:N6-succinyllysine on K. Their ptm_sites rows exist and carry modification_name, with modification null, so a query by name finds them and a query by UNIMOD accession will not.

27 channel(s) of the search's TmtDesign.txt are not study samples: `Sample Type` empty: `PXD032900-tmt:KMS_TMT:TMT126`, `PXD032900-tmt:KMS_TMT:TMT127C`, `PXD032900-tmt:KMS_TMT:TMT127N`, `PXD032900-tmt:KMS_TMT:TMT128C`, `PXD032900-tmt:KMS_TMT:TMT128N` and 22 more. Their values measure that reference, not a sample of the question. The design is copied in `sources/`.

PTM site occupancy was not stored: this is a TMT dataset, and MetaMorpheus computes intensity occupancy for label-free searches only; its count occupancy is per file, repeated on every channel (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT). `ptm_stoichiometry` has no rows here because of that, not because no site was modified.

dataset.summary: PXD032900-tmt is a DDA isobaric dataset (Mus musculus) with 3 runs, 54 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.14. At 1% FDR the search reports 8,083 PSMs, 4,188 peptidoforms and 1,354 protein groups, and the repository holds 9,057 PTM sites for it. 6 open warnings about it are recorded. It is one part of deposit PXD032900, which was searched in parts (split by label). No other part of it is in this repository.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
